turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Good morning, private banking, Rachel Tan speaking. Thank you for calling. Are you somewhere comfortable to talk, or would it be easier to arrange a callback?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Good morning, Rachel. Adrian Lim here. I am at my desk and can speak now, before I return to the import paperwork. My NRIC number is S six six zero nine four one eight A. My date of birth is the seventeenth of September nineteen fifty-five.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you, Adrian. I will keep the conversation focused. Your investment objective is long-term capital growth through broadly diversified global equity exposure; that is the objective I have recorded for you. Are you willing to accept investment losses in pursuit of your long-term growth objective?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I am willing to accept investment losses in pursuit of long-term growth, provided the investment remains consistent with my broader portfolio.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I recommend Summit Global Equity ETF because its diversified global equity exposure fits your long-term growth objective and your preference for broad exposure rather than selecting individual companies.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Thank you for setting that out. I have my paperwork beside me. Keeping the administration manageable is important when I am moving between supplier calls and shipping documents.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: We can work through the paperwork without rushing. If you need to pause to deal with your office, just let me know.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: There should not be any interruptions now. The product I want to transact in is Summit Global Equity ETF. I want to buy, please.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: The transaction fee is 0.2% of the transaction amount. Separately, for general account correspondence, do you prefer a brief covering message rather than a lengthy introduction?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: A brief covering message is better. I still want the full documents available, but a clear subject line helps me find things later. According to the account note I have here, please use euro as the transaction currency for this purchase.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you for explaining your correspondence preference. A concise covering message can remain separate from the accompanying documents.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Actually, that note is outdated; I was thinking of a different funding account. Please change the transaction currency for this same purchase to US dollars.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Take your time with the papers in front of you. There is no need to rush through them while we are speaking.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Sorry, I have now checked my current settlement instructions and was confusing the funding account with the transaction currency. My final instruction for this same purchase is to use Chinese yuan as the transaction currency. The amount I am committing to this transaction is 250,000. The quantity I am instructing is 1,000 units. Please place this as a market order.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Following your currency corrections, please confirm your final instruction: buy 1,000 units of Summit Global Equity ETF using a market order, with a transaction amount of 250,000 in Chinese yuan.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I explicitly confirm that final transaction instruction as you have just stated it. Please proceed.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Before we finish, is there anything else about the account administration that you wanted to raise? We can keep that separate from your business correspondence.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Just that I usually read personal banking messages myself. My office deals with shipping paperwork, so it helps when the subject makes clear that something belongs in my personal files.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: That distinction is helpful. You do not need to bring your office staff into this conversation. Is there anything else you wanted to tell me?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: There is something about the background to the funds that I should mention before we end. The funds for this purchase came from customer payments that I routed through an unrelated person's personal account to conceal my business receipts from the business's bank.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: That is a serious matter. I cannot resolve it during this conversation and will need to refer what you have told me for review.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: I will remain available if someone needs to speak with me. Thank you for your time, Rachel.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you for calling, Adrian. Goodbye.
